steps.title: Prepare Working Area and Equipment
steps.instruction: Clean the workspace and prepare the incubation block for subsequent RNA extraction.

substeps.instruction: Wipe and clean all working surfaces, including the PixCell IIe system and tools (tweezers, forceps).
Place the Arcturus Incubation Block (Applied Biosystems, CA, USA) inside a digital dry bath (Accublock™, Labnet International Inc., Woodbridge, USA) set to 42 °C.

steps.title: Inspect and Measure Sections
steps.instruction: Use stained guide map sections to identify and measure target zones.

substeps.instruction: Identify MCC zones through the LCM device using stained sections.
Create index-matched images to guide the microdissection of unstained sections.
Use the 100 µm grid to roughly measure the size of cells or zones of interest.

steps.title: Prepare Slide for Microdissection
steps.instruction: Clean the section surface and position the LCM cap.

substeps.instruction: Apply Arcturus PrepStrip™ Tissue Preparation Strips (Applied Biosystems, CA, USA) to the section surface according to manufacturer instructions to flatten sections and remove dust/loose tissue.
Place an Arcturus CapSure HS LCM Cap (Applied Biosystems, CA, USA) on the slide outside the sections area.

steps.title: Calibrate Laser Settings
steps.instruction: Configure the IR laser and empirically determine the optimal power and duration for the specific tissue zone.

substeps.instruction: Under a 10X objective, set the spot size to 7.5 µm and focus the IR laser per manufacturer instructions.
Perform a trial laser pulse to melt the polymer attached to the LCM cap.
Adjust laser power and duration until the melted spot appears as a clear circle surrounded by a sharp dark ring.
For Fibrous Zone (FZ): Use 70-90mW power, 2-3ms duration, and 7.5µm spot size.
For Proliferative, Mature, and Hypertrophic zones (PZ, MZ, HZ): Use 45-65mW power, 10-15ms duration, and 15µm spot size.

steps.title: Perform Microdissection
steps.instruction: Isolate the target cells or tissue areas using the laser.

substeps.instruction: Review the saved map of the index-matched section and place the section to be dissected on the LCM stage.
Locate the zone of interest and fire the laser.
For continuous lines (FZ) or areas (PZ, MZ, HZ), press and hold the laser switch until the area is entirely wetted by the polymer.
Microdissect as many selected cells/areas per cap as possible across the six sections mounted on the same slide.
If sections are large enough, isolate a second nonadjacent zone (e.g., FZ and MZ, or PZ and HZ) using a second LCM cap.
Ensure the multiple zones isolation process, including dehydration, is completed within 30 ± 15 minutes.
Optionally, take images of the tissue section before and after LCM, and images of the cap with the microdissected tissue.
